name: Logia mastery
description: Become and produce an element: Willpower speeds the control.

stages.name: Making the element
stages.description: Make a little of it, on purpose.
stages.text: A little of the element came from your hand when you wanted it to.

stages.name: Controlled intangibility
stages.description: Let a blow pass through on purpose.
stages.text: A blade went through you and you let it.

stages.name: Reflex intangibility
stages.description: Turn to the element without thinking.
stages.text: You were hit from behind and did not even notice: your body had turned on its own.

stages.name: Large-scale element
stages.text: You covered the whole field in it.

stages.name: Element and haki together
stages.text: Your element and your haki moved as one.

stages.name: Awakening
stages.description: The element spreads into the world and stays there a while.
stages.text: The element poured out of you into the world, and stayed: you had awakened.
